# NVIDIA Content Agents

Reference implementation of agentic OpenUSD/USD content workflows for
conversion, material and texture authoring, physics, articulation,
segmentation, validation, and scene processing. Read, fork, and adapt this
release; do not treat it as a stable SDK or deploy-as-is product.

Expanded index: `llms-full.txt`. Full repo-local agent contract: `AGENTS.md`.

## Default v0.6 Entry

- Start from the repository root.
- Read `README.md`, this compact index, `AGENTS.md`, and the selected root skill
  in that order. Use `llms-full.txt` for the expanded command and skill index
  and `agentic/README.md` for implementation details.
- On native Linux or WSL2, set up with `./scripts/setup_content_agent.sh`.
- Native Windows execution is unsupported in the 0.6 release. On a Windows
  host, run the supported workflow inside WSL2.
- Require Python 3.12 and `uv`; require Node.js 20+ and `npm` only for workflows
  that launch Codex or Claude Code.
- Use `content-workflow-cli` and root `content-workflow-*` skills by default.
- Write outputs under root `runs/`.
- Use a fixed pipeline app CLI, YAML, benchmark, Python, or REST interface only when
  explicitly requested.
- The established application workflows under `apps/` are the fixed pipeline.
- Invoke the root `$fixed-pipeline` umbrella only when one of those interfaces
  is explicitly requested.
- Never silently fall back to fixed pipeline.

## Windows Hosts

Run the supported 0.6 workflow inside WSL2 and clone into the WSL2 Linux
filesystem so the repository's skill symlinks materialize correctly. If
`.agents/skills/content-workflow-material` is not a directory, stop and clone
again inside WSL2. Do not continue with a partial skill inventory.

## Agentic Commands

```bash
content-workflow-cli --help
content-workflow-cli convert-to-usd --help
content-workflow-cli materials assign --help
content-workflow-cli texture run --help
content-workflow-cli physics apply --help
content-workflow-cli mesh-segmentation run --help
content-workflow-cli validate run --help
content-workflow-cli simready --help
content-workflow-cli scene run --help
content-workflow-cli articulation run --help
content-workflow-cli asset run --help
```

## Canonical Skills

- Canonical tree: `.agents/skills/`
- Codex mirror: `.codex/skills/`
- Claude Code mirror: `.claude/skills/`
- General launcher: `.agents/skills/content-workflow-cli/SKILL.md`
- usd-cli: `.agents/skills/usd-cli/SKILL.md`
- Composed asset: `.agents/skills/content-workflow-asset/SKILL.md`
- Conversion: `.agents/skills/content-workflow-convert-to-usd/SKILL.md`
- Material: `.agents/skills/content-workflow-material/SKILL.md`
- Mesh segmentation: `.agents/skills/content-workflow-mesh-segmentation/SKILL.md`
- Physics: `.agents/skills/content-workflow-physics/SKILL.md`
- SimReady: `.agents/skills/content-workflow-simready/SKILL.md`
- Validation: `.agents/skills/content-workflow-validation/SKILL.md`
- Large scene: `.agents/skills/content-workflow-large-scene/SKILL.md`

## Explicit Fixed Pipeline Interfaces

- Material: `apps/material_agent/README.md`, `material-agent`
- Material API: `apps/material_agent/docs/api.md`
- Physics: `apps/physics_agent/README.md`, `physics-agent`
- Physics API: `apps/physics_agent/docs/api.md`
- Joint: `apps/joint_agent/README.md`, `joint-agent`
- Joint service: `apps/joint_agent_service/README.md`
- Texture: `apps/texture_agent/README.md`, `texture-agent`
- Texture service API: `apps/texture_agent_service/docs/api.md`
- Validation: `apps/validation_agent/README.md`, `validation-agent`
- Validation examples: `apps/validation_agent/examples/README.md`
- REST services: `apps/*_agent_service/`

The sole discoverable fixed-pipeline skill is
`.agents/skills/fixed-pipeline/SKILL.md`, mirrored at
`.codex/skills/fixed-pipeline/SKILL.md` and
`.claude/skills/fixed-pipeline/SKILL.md`. It loads only the required retained
reference from `.agents/skills/fixed-pipeline/references/`; those references
are not independently invocable skills.

Keep API keys in `.env` or environment variables and never print or commit
secrets.
